laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Loading: 10-15× total daily oral haloperidol dose, capped at 100 mg per injection (split across two injections if >100 mg total). Continue oral haloperidol at half dose for ~4 weeks post first injection. Maintenance every 4 weeks.

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~21 days. Steady state in 2-3 months. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Reduced haloperidol
activeMetabolite.notes: Same as oral haloperidol — minor contribution. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: Same CYP profile as oral haloperidol. Inhibitors worsen EPS at depot dose; depot kinetics amplify the consequence. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Minimal metabolic burden — historical reason FGA depots persist. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Slow depot taper provides smoother withdrawal than oral. Tardive dyskinesia after long-term use is the main concern, not rebound. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Sesame oil vehicle. Deep gluteal IM. QTc check at baseline and after dose stabilisation. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
